banner: Methodology dashboard: ranks are the best-supported order under fixed model settings

pressure_separation.units: bowler runs per six legal events (legal-only diagnostic)

top_limitations: Pressure-specific uplift is not established: only 1 of 2 required pooled effects passed. All 6 standardized phase-by-innings intervals include zero. Dismissal effect h=0.142; dot -0.052; boundary -0.007.

Placebos reproduce much of the order: mean top-10 overlap 5.73/10 batting and 7.36/10 bowling; mean Spearman batting 0.501, bowling 0.846. Actual score spread (SD, index points): batting 0.821, bowling 3.173; mean placebo batting 0.759, bowling 2.998.
Ordering is unstable: split-half Spearman 0.335 batting / 0.257 bowling; pressure-quantile overlap 6-7/10. Nationality-filtered research top-15 fragile ranks: 15/15 batting, 15/15 bowling.

glossary.Index: Our summary score. 50 is neutral; higher means stronger evidence under this fixed method. It is not a forecast.
glossary.Baseline: The same player's usual level on ordinary-pressure balls. Those balls are kept separate from his pressure balls.
glossary.Shrinkage: A caution step: when the evidence is noisy, estimated gains are pulled back toward zero.
glossary.Tier: A minimum evidence rule. Only Tier 1 is ranked; Tier 2 estimates stay in a reference CSV.
glossary.Interval: A range from repeating the match samples with the settings held fixed. The middle 95% of results is shown; other uncertainty remains. Rank ranges and top-10 frequencies use the frozen original pool.
glossary.Fragile rank: A place that needs caution: the score range includes 50, the rank range spans more than 10 places, or a top-10 player stays there in fewer than 50% of repeats.

executive_summary: When time runs short and wickets fall, cricket gets harder. We studied those situations and compared each player with his own usual level. These are the leading names under our fixed scoring method. The ranges show how much the score and place can move when matches are sampled again. Most places are uncertain, and we have not proved a separate pressure skill.
scope_sentence: Pakistani and Bangladeshi national-team players were outside the candidate pool by the team's choice.

summary.uncertainty_basis: Display places reflect the selection constraints. Rank intervals and top-10 repeat frequencies refer to the frozen original comparison pool, before the individual exclusion. They were not re-estimated.

pressure.normalization: fixed bounded components; innings-specific training-free quantiles

ratings.interval_method: match bootstrap; expectation and EB parameters held fixed

pressure_components: Chase closeness = exp(-abs(required rate - par pace) / 5); first innings = 1.
Wickets lost are counted before this delivery.
Chase gap = required rate - par pace. First innings = (par - projected total) / 20 overs.
Uses match context known before the delivery.
technical_appendix.projection_formula: Projected total = 120 x (runs before + 24 x par / 120) / (legal balls before + 24).
technical_appendix.component_formula: w = (0.45, 0.25, 0.15, 0.15) for runs, wickets, dots, boundaries.
technical_appendix.diagnostic_cohort: Diagnostic checks use their original all-player eligible cohorts and frozen settings. Selection exclusions do not refit these checks.
